findings.summary: agent_doctor reports executable as null for aliases even when underlying command exists in PATH
evidence: In agent_doctor.py line 207: 'executable': shutil.which(cmd['agent']) if cmd['kind'] == 'default' else None.
When claude is defined as an alias in ~/.zshrc, cmd['kind'] is 'alias', resulting in 'executable': null even though the binary may be present in PATH.
